name: Game ni Natta yo! Dokuro-chan
original_name: ゲームになったよ!ドクロちゃん
source:
Bokusatsu Tenshi Dokuro-chan tells the story of 13-year-old junior high schooler [url=/c77642]Kusakabe Sakura[/url], who twenty years in the future develops a technology that causes all women to stop physically aging after they reach twelve years old in an attempt to create a "Pedophile's World". However, this act accidentally creates immortality amongst humans, thus offending God. [url=/c77641]Mitsukai Dokuro[/url], a member of an order of assassin angels that are called Rurutie, has been sent from the future to kill him. Believing that Sakura can be redeemed, Dokuro decides instead to keep Sakura so occupied and distracted that he can never develop the immortality technology. 

Due to her impulsive nature and super-human strength however, she frequently kills him with her gigantic spiked kanabou (club), Excalibolg, on a moment's impulse, but returns him to life moments later with angelic power, typically reciting her personal chant "Pipiru-piru-piru-pipiru-pi" (which has no meaning at all and is just a habit of hers). 

[url=/c77643]Mihashigo Sabato[/url], another assassin of the Rurutie order who uses her feminine wiles along with her electric baton to do her job, is dispatched to complete Dokuro's original mission: Sakura's assassination.

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bludgeoning_Angel_Dokuro-Chan]Wikipedia[/url]]

The game features Sakura trying to establish a relationship between him and any of the girls in his environment.
translation: 《棒杀天使骷髅酱》讲述了13岁初中生草下樱的故事——他在二十年后开发了一种技术，让所有女性在12岁后停止身体衰老，企图创造一个萝莉控的世界。然而这一行为意外地创造了人类的永生，冒犯了神明。御使骷髅是一个名为璐璐蒂的刺客天使组织的成员，被从未来派来杀死他。骷髅相信樱可以被救赎，于是决定让樱忙得不可开交，让他永远无法开发出永生技术。但由于她冲动的性格和超人的力量，她经常在一时冲动下用巨大的狼牙棒杀死他，但片刻之后又用天使的力量将他复活，通常念着她的个人咒语"皮皮露"（这毫无意义，只是她的习惯）。Mihashigo Sabato是璐璐蒂组织的另一位刺客，利用女性魅力和电击棒完成任务，被派来执行骷髅的原始任务：暗杀樱。游戏的特色是樱试图与周围的任何一个女孩建立关系。
